title: log
description: The archiver: consume what the redirect service recorded about each request, and write it to an object store as NDJSON. It owns no database and answers no calls.

prefix.description: What every key this component writes begins with. A bucket is usually shared, and a component that writes to the root of one cannot be given permission to write only its own objects.

batch.description: When to close an object and write it. Both limits apply: whichever is reached first. A size-only rule means a quiet hour is never archived; a time-only rule means a busy one is archived in objects too small to be worth reading.

maxRecords.description: Write once this many records are held.

maxSeconds.description: Write this long after the first record of a batch arrived, however few there are.
